controles.affirmation: Litige Halozyme : plainte alleguant la contrefacon de 15 brevets sur le pembrolizumab sous-cutane ; le PTAB a invalide tous les claims contestes dans les 4 premieres decisions ; 'Un blocage ou des redevances forcees affaibliraient la principale parade de Merck'
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2025, Halozyme filed a complaint in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey alleging that the Company's activities related to subcutaneous pembrolizumab infringe or will infringe 15 patents belonging to the MDASE portfolio... The PTAB has since issued FWDs regarding four of the instituted PGR petitions finding every challenged claim unpatentable.
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune correction obligatoire, mais l'ATT presente le blocage comme hypothetique alors qu'il est deja partiellement survenu. Le meme paragraphe du 10-Q indique : 'Following a one day hearing in December 2025, a preliminary injunction was awarded against the Company, prohibiting sales in Germany. The Company has appealed... the appeal hearing is set for November 19, 2026.' Ajouter cette phrase renforcerait l'anti-these sans risque.

controles.affirmation: Merck anticipe que Keytruda sera selectionne en 2027 pour un prix impose effectif au 1er janvier 2029 ; Merck a attaque l'Etat en justice sur ce programme
controles.verbatim_source: the Company expects that Keytruda (pembrolizumab) will be selected in 2027 for government price setting, which would become effective on January 1, 2029... The Company has sued the U.S. government regarding the IRA's Program.

controles.affirmation: Januvia et Janumet ont perdu leur exclusivite americaine en mai 2026, Janumet XR en juillet 2026 ; Merck perdra une part substantielle de ces ventes ; franchise diabete -31% au T2 2026 (429 M$ vs 623 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: Januvia and Janumet lost market exclusivity in the U.S. in May 2026 and Janumet XR lost market exclusivity in the U.S. in July 2026. The Company expects that it will lose a substantial portion of U.S. sales of Januvia, Janumet and Janumet XR sales in future periods due to generic competition. / Worldwide combined sales of Januvia and Janumet ... declined 31% and 29% in the second quarter and first six months of 2026

controles.affirmation: Une proposition du CDC (suspendue par la justice) de passer a une dose unique chez les adolescents reduirait encore les volumes americains si elle aboutissait
controles.verbatim_source: Among the changes in the CDC's now-stayed January announcement referenced above was a reduction of the recommended doses for HPV vaccination of adolescents to a single dose... The Company anticipates that any negative effect of these recommendations or reduced dosing schedules on sales of Gardasil/Gardasil 9 will not be material.
controles.correction_proposee: L'ATT omet la conclusion explicite de Merck. Reformuler : 'Une proposition du CDC (suspendue par la justice) de passer a une dose unique chez les adolescents pourrait peser sur les volumes americains, meme si Merck estime que l'effet de ces recommandations ou d'un schema de dosage reduit ne sera pas significatif sur les ventes de Gardasil.' Ou retirer le passage, qui n'est pas soutenu par le document cite.

controles.affirmation: Keytruda/Keytruda Qlex : 16,4 Mds $ au S1 2026, soit 49,9% des 32,9 Mds $ de ventes totales ; Qlex 590 M$ au S1 2026
Perte nette de 5,575 Mds $ au S1 2026 contre +9,506 Mds $ un an avant, due aux charges IPR&D Cidara (9,0 Mds $) et Terns (5,7 Mds $) ; acquisitions 9,2 + 6,8 = 16 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: Net (Loss) Income Attributable to Merck & Co., Inc. $ (5,575) $ 9,506 / Merck recorded a charge of $9.0 billion to Research and development expenses (Cidara, MK-1406, Phase 3 trial) / Merck recorded a charge of $5.7 billion (Terns, MK-4208, Phase 1/2)

controles.affirmation: Dette long terme 51,1 Mds $ au 30 juin 2026 contre 34,0 Mds $ un an plus tot (+50%) ; tresorerie de 14,6 a 6,8 Mds $ ; cash-flow operationnel 9,3 Mds $ ; dividendes 4,2 Mds $ ; rachats 1,6 Md $
controles.verbatim_source: Long-Term Debt 51,081 / 46,750 (10-Q T2 2026) ; Long-Term Debt 33,968 (10-Q T2 2025, 30 juin 2025) ; Cash and cash equivalents $6,849 / $14,565 ; Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities 9,288 ; Dividends paid to stockholders (4,249) ; Purchases of treasury stock (1,631)

controles.affirmation: Les acquisitions ont ete financees par un pret relais de 6 Mds $ et une emission de dette de 6 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: Proceeds from term loan 6,000 / Payments on term loan (6,000) / Proceeds from issuance of debt 5,956 ; 'The Company has since repaid borrowings under the Credit Agreement.'
controles.correction_proposee: Exact mais incomplet : le pret relais de 6 Mds $ a ete integralement rembourse dans le meme semestre. Preciser 'un pret relais de 6 Mds $ depuis rembourse' pour eviter de laisser croire qu'il pese encore au bilan.

controles.affirmation: Ventes mondiales de Gardasil -9% au S1 2026 (Chine, Japon, achats CDC) ; revenus du contrat revise en Chine attendus 'immaterial' en 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Combined worldwide sales of Gardasil and Gardasil 9 declined 9% in the first six months of 2026 primarily driven by lower demand in China (discussed below) and in Japan... The year-to-date sales decline also reflects lower sales in the U.S. primarily due to unfavorable CDC purchasing patterns... revenue associated with the revised supply contract is expected to be immaterial in 2026.

controles.affirmation: Keytruda : les biosimilaires pourraient commencer en decembre 2028 aux Etats-Unis, ventes materiellement affectees entre 2028 et 2029, Europe 2031
controles.verbatim_source: the Company expects that sales of Keytruda will be materially negatively impacted by biosimilar competition between 2028 and 2029... biosimilar competition could begin in December 2028 when the primary compound patent expires. The Company also expects to lose market exclusivity in Europe for Keytruda in 2031
